items.description: Close opening and repaint affected wall
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed area. One combined repair at €350 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the building-services invoice: one flat rate at €81 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing consumables used in the pipe repair. One billed unit at €18 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) support the first replacement section for the failed internal supply pipe, assuming equivalent specification: 1 m at €55 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired section at its pre-loss standard: 1 m at €28 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installation labour. The invoiced 1 hour at the installer rate of €63 gives €63 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes a separate charge for the contractor's own measuring device, even though necessary investigation labour is covered. The conditional estimate is €25 for one deployment.
Sections 7.1.7(e) and (g) cover necessary investigation and repair labour. The full invoiced 9 hours give €425 gross at the supplied rate.
Section 7.1.7(f) permits only the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice, even for multiple visits. The conditional estimate is €81 for one charge.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per operation. The photo shows one portable air mover; one flat rate is estimated at €80 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) specifically excludes the contractor's blades as business equipment. The conditional estimate is €15 for one blade.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers compatible fittings used to reconnect the replacement pipe. Two fittings at €38 each give €76 gross.
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude repeat or unsupported material charges; no distinct second pipe section is documented. If separately substantiated, 1 m would be €55 gross.
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude a second insulation charge unless it is shown to cover distinct work beyond line 5. If substantiated, 1 m of standard shell would be €28 gross.

Section 7.1.8(c) excludes repeated labour charges. The additional visit could justify distinct hours, but this identical entry does not distinguish them from line 8; if substantiated, the full 9 hours give €425 gross.
